versions.changelog:
Initial release of research-paper-orchestrator.

- Coordinates 10 specialized subagents to generate complete doctorate-level research papers (12,000–15,000 words).
- Supports major citation systems (APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, IEEE, Vancouver).
- Outputs professionally formatted Word documents (.docx) with all academic sections.
- Includes rigorous quality checks and multi-phase workflow (from topic analysis to final delivery).
- Suitable for dissertations, theses, and comprehensive academic papers.
